title: Strategic road corridors in Great Britain: motorways, trunk roads and primary A roads (OS Open Roads)
coverage: Great Britain. Northern Ireland: not included (OSNI's open transport service could not be reached from the data pipeline)
attribution: Contains OS data © Crown copyright and database right 2026

retrieval.method: Extracted on GitHub Actions (fetch-open-roads) from the OS Open Roads GeoPackage
retrieval.notes: Links merged by road number and category, simplified at 60.0 m in EPSG:27700: 'strategic' = motorways and trunk roads (the national highway authorities' networks), 'primary' = other primary-route A roads. Lines show road corridors, not freight flows.
